title: Fix Go 1.27 FIPS module checksum validation (LP: #2169165)
description:
Go 1.27 enforces strict compile-time checksum validation on the bundled fips140 module archive against fips140.sum. The Ubuntu build pipeline invokes dh_strip_nondeterminism, which strips metadata and alters timestamps on all .zip files. This modification breaks the strict checksum verification, causing the Go 1.27 compiler to abort during builds and test executions.


[Changes]

- debian/rules: Explicitly exclude the native FIPS module zip from the strip process using:
  --exclude=usr/lib/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140/*.zip


[Verification]

- PPA Build: https://launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/+archive/ubuntu/fix-go-native-fips/+packages?field.name_filter=golang-1.27
- Autopkgtests: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/user/sumit-tiwari/ppa/fix-go-native-fips
